LESSON: NULLIFIERS OF SAUM

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Devotional Acts
Topic 4.4.1: Nullifiers of Saum

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Nullifiers of Saum
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why should Muslims observe rules and regulation when fasting?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify the nullifiers of saum to safeguard the validity of saum
2. practise saum as a pillar of Islam
3. appreciate fasting as a means of gaining taqwa (piety)
